answer: Bounty-driven disputed-stake escrow stops bulk identity forgery. Each identity locks 200 units in a vault for 12 epochs, open to challenge by anyone. Five random jurors rule in 2 epochs, verdicts crystal clear: confirmed fraud burns 70%, 20% rewards the challenger. Forging 1,000 ties up 200,000 units; each clone found costs 140. Batch creators cluster like a cedar grove on referral graphs, flagged before cashing out.
